# Genfinity O&P

> Genfinity O&P is an orthotic and prosthetic clinic in Tarzana, Los Angeles, providing personalized orthotics, prosthetics, custom foot orthotics, diabetic footwear, pediatric bracing, and long-term fitting support.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://genfinityoandp.com/): Overview of the clinic and care offered.
- [About](https://genfinityoandp.com/about): Mission, clinical approach, and experience.
- [Services](https://genfinityoandp.com/services): Overview of orthotic, prosthetic, and custom insole services.
- [Custom orthotics](https://genfinityoandp.com/services/orthotics): Custom and custom-fit orthotic care.
- [Prosthetics](https://genfinityoandp.com/services/prosthetics): Personalized lower- and upper-extremity prosthetic care.
- [Custom foot orthotics](https://genfinityoandp.com/services/custom-insoles): Custom insoles, gait assessment, and pressure relief.
- [Patient resources](https://genfinityoandp.com/patient-resources): Appointment, insurance, financial, and care-process guidance.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://genfinityoandp.com/faqs): Common questions about devices, visits, prescriptions, and insurance.
- [Location and hours](https://genfinityoandp.com/locations): Tarzana clinic address, hours, and directions.
- [Contact](https://genfinityoandp.com/contact): Contact form and consultation information.

## Important guidance

- Website information is educational and does not replace individual medical advice.
- For a medical emergency, call 911 or seek emergency medical care.
- Do not submit private health information through general email or the public contact form.
- The patient registration and staff areas are private workflows and should not be indexed or summarized.
